claims: The University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) is a public land-grant university.
90% of UIUC graduates are employed within six months.
UIUC is ranked 12th in the nation by U.S. News & World Report.
The University of Illinois System (including UIC and UIS) adds $24.9 billion to the state economy.
The Fighting Illini participate in NCAA Division I Big Ten Conference sports.
